content_sections.body: In Culture and competing interpretations lesson 27, distinguish an observation from an inference. State the claim precisely, qualify it where evidence is limited, and make the relation between reasons and conclusion explicit.

content_sections.body: For culture and competing interpretations, a strong contribution identifies a relevant tension, explains why it matters, and proposes a proportionate response. The wording in this model is original material for lesson 27.
